title: Opus 5.5 made this
summary: Topic mode, skill-info-graphics: the video shows how it was made. One prompt goes in; the model writes, voices, builds and times it; the editor is the model; the last word points at the video itself.

beats.onScreen: Dark ground. A prompt bar types its request; the cursor clicks Generate after the word prompt.
beats.sound: Voice, typing, click, music bed low

beats.words: Opus 5.5 wrote this script, chose this voice, built every frame, and timed every sound.
beats.onScreen: Cream ground arcs in. An orange orbit with Opus 5.5 at the core; chips Script, Voice, Frames, Sound pop on their words and turn slowly.
beats.sound: Voice, swipe, pop, a tick per chip, music ducked

beats.words: No editing app. No human editor.
beats.onScreen: Light grey ground wipes in. Editor = a key cap reading Opus 5.5.
beats.sound: Voice, swipe, tick on the operator, pop on the key cap

beats.onScreen: Dark ground irises in. Opus 5.5 / made / this. in heavy type, this in orange, an arrow down to the video.

notes: Voices leveled to -14 LUFS / -3.6 dBTP (lesson 13bc). Music: library bg-music-daily-mail.mp3, looped with a 1.5 s crossfade to cover 10 s, leveled to -18 LUFS, lane 0.6, duck 0.4. Its licence is not recorded.
